uv run python - <<'PY'
import hashlib
import numpy as np

def load(p):
    t = np.loadtxt(p, delimiter=",", skiprows=1)
    return t[:, :-1], t[:, -1]

Xp, yp = load("data/pilot.csv")
Xh, yh = load("data/heldout.csv")
print("pilot", Xp.shape, "pos", (yp==1).sum(), "neg", (yp==-1).sum())
print("heldout", Xh.shape, "pos", (yh==1).sum(), "neg", (yh==-1).sum())
print("headers equal:", open("data/pilot.csv").readline() == open("data/heldout.csv").readline())
print("NaNs:", np.isnan(Xp).sum(), np.isnan(Xh).sum())
print("constant cols pilot:", int((Xp.std(0)==0).sum()), "heldout:", int((Xh.std(0)==0).sum()))

def h(r): return hashlib.md5(r.tobytes()).hexdigest()
pset = {h(r) for r in Xp}
hset = {h(r) for r in Xh}
print("heldout rows also in pilot:", sum(h(r) in pset for r in Xh))
print("exact dup rows within heldout:", Xh.shape[0] - len(hset))
